The '''MC30c frigate''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]-designed [[Warship/Legends|warship]], utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
Considered one of the most powerful mid-level frigates used in the war, the MC30c [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] utilized [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] as well as turbolaser batteries to bombard larger enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in combat. In addition to this, it was also one of the fastest ships of its type.<ref name="SW:EAW:FOC" />

[[File:Mc30views.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Different profile views of a MC30c [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]].]]
The greatest weakness of the ship was that it had very light armor. If heavy fire was concentrated on the frigate, it would most likely be destroyed.<ref name="SW:EAW:FOC" />

It was also common for these vessels to utilize [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]] that could damage enemy targets around the ship. The cluster bombs were intended as a last defense against fighters and bombers. These proved very effective against clusters of such vessels; though once the bombs were depleted, the only real defense the MC30c frigate had against star fighters were its laser cannons, which could quickly destroy starfighters. However, if bombers were close enough to the ship, the frigate could be easily destroyed due to its limited armor .<ref name="SW:EAW:FOC" />

The shield generator of the ship, like other Mon Calamari craft, was hidden within the superstructure and therefore harder to destroy. This allowed the shields to regenerate at a continuous rate, even if the weapons systems suffered damage.<ref name="SW:EAW:FOC" />

==History==
The MC30c frigate was among the [[Navy/Legends|space forces]] available to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="SW:EAW:FOC" /> with at least one of the frigates among the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[0 ABY/Legends|approximately nine months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWR15">[[Rebellion 15|''Rebellion'' 15]]</ref> During the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the MC30c frigate was included with an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in the background of a [[X-Wing (painting)|painting]] depicting a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] with three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' to 5 ABY.</ref> early in the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], MC30 frigates were present in the skies of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], alongside other ships such as [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 transports]] and [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], during [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aspirant [[Kyle Katarn]]'s [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|encounter]] with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] information broker [[8t88/Legends|8t88]].<ref name="SW:JK:DFII">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MC30c_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art for the MC30c frigate.]]
The MC30c frigate's design originated as [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] concept art created in the production of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Art of ROTJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The design was later included in the [[1997]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', making a brief appearance in the introduction to the Nar Shaddaa level, and was identified as the MC30c frigate for [[2006]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''
